name: AMMB Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年 AmBank 完成以 RM331 million 收购 Menara AmBank 及相关资产与权利，并完成多项休眠子公司的成员自愿清盘。公司没有公告新的业务线、产能扩张或合约。
overview_en: This year AmBank completed the acquisition of Menara AmBank together with related assets and rights for RM331 million, and completed the members' voluntary winding-up of several dormant subsidiaries. There were no announcements of new business lines, capacity expansion or contracts.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面完成 Menara AmBank 的收购，并完成多家休眠子公司的清盘。
segments.note_en: At group level, the acquisition of Menara AmBank was completed this year, and several dormant subsidiaries completed their winding-up.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 休眠子公司 Malco Properties Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘，于 2026 年 11 月 4 日解散。
actions.text_en: Dormant subsidiary Malco Properties Sdn Bhd completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved on 4 November 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: AmBank 于 2026 年 10 月 23 日支付收购 Menara AmBank 的余款，收购完成。
actions.text_en: On 23 October 2026, AmBank settled the remaining balance of the purchase consideration for Menara AmBank, completing the acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: MOE 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日确认对收购 Menara AmBank 无异议。
actions.text_en: On 27 July 2026, the MOE confirmed that it had no objections to the acquisition of Menara AmBank.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: AmBank 于 2026 年 7 月 2 日就收购 Menara AmBank 向 MOE 提交申请。
actions.text_en: On 2 July 2026, AmBank submitted its application to the MOE in respect of the acquisition of Menara AmBank.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 休眠子公司 AmInvestment Management Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘，于 2026 年 6 月 25 日解散。
actions.text_en: Dormant subsidiary AmInvestment Management Sdn Bhd completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved on 25 June 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: AmBank 于 2026 年 6 月 8 日与 Maybank Trustees Berhad（代表 AmFIRST REIT）签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM331 million 现金收购 Menara AmBank 及相关资产与权利。
actions.text_en: On 8 June 2026, AmBank entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Maybank Trustees Berhad (for and on behalf of AmFIRST REIT) to acquire Menara AmBank together with related assets and rights for a cash consideration of RM331 million.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 休眠子公司 AMMB Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘，于 2026 年 3 月 1 日解散。
actions.text_en: Dormant subsidiary AMMB Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved on 1 March 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 休眠子公司 AmResearch Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘，于 2026 年 2 月 18 日解散。
actions.text_en: Dormant subsidiary AmResearch Sdn Bhd completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved on 18 February 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 休眠子公司 AmFutures Sdn Bhd 完成成员自愿清盘，于 2026 年 1 月 14 日解散。
actions.text_en: Dormant subsidiary AmFutures Sdn Bhd completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved on 14 January 2026.
